title: We ship our tiny phone games with Claude Code, and built a CLI so your agent can do the same
author: rip222
selftext:
Small team, all experienced devs, and we've leaned hard into Claude Code for our app Dead Simple (a swipe feed of small games).



The part people here might like: we built the creator CLI for agents first. \`deadsimple\` has a local hub for humans, but every command also answers in \`--json\`, so Claude can scaffold a game, build it, run the contract test and get it ready for upload without you touching a terminal. You never hand the agent your login code, only the session.



Games are a single HTML file. Libraries like Three.js load from our mirror, so they don't count against the 5 MB limit.



Glad to share the prompt and workflow we use to go from idea to a published game.



Play the feed: [https://deadsimple.games](https://deadsimple.games)



Make games: [https://studio.deadsimple.games](https://studio.deadsimple.games)
